start.headline: Find where AI helps in your work
start.explanation: AI may handle a task you find difficult and struggle with one you find easy. Find out by trying your own examples, then decide how you want to work.
start.purpose: Test a task, make a considered choice and try one change to your routine.
start.bookNote: This unofficial companion explores a small selection of ideas from Co-Existence by Ethan Mollick. It works best alongside the book, which develops the arguments, evidence and qualifications in much greater depth.

labels.readMore: Read more in the book: chapter {chapter}
labels.introReadMore: Read more in the book: Introduction

test.instruction: Copy a prompt into your own AI tool. Return here to record what happened.
test.evidenceNote: A guess does not count as a test. No recorded result means this task remains untested.
test.privacyNote: Use only inputs you are allowed to share with that tool. A fictional example may be enough to start.
test.transferNote: Pasting information into another AI tool is your action and is subject to that tool’s data practices.

decide.instruction: Use what you observed to choose an arrangement you can evaluate and sustain. You can change it later.

choices.label: Use AI
choices.help: Choose clear handoffs or work back and forth. Record the check you will use.

choices.label: Delegate to an agent with oversight
choices.help: Define the assignment, its limits, completion checks and any needed review points.

choices.label: Keep deliberately
choices.help: Name the contribution you want to make yourself. It may cover only part of the task.

choices.label: Undecided
choices.help: Record the uncertainty and what evidence would help.

keepReasons.label: Accountability
keepReasons.help: Responsibility remains with me in every mode; choosing this records a reason for my own direct involvement.

map.caveat: This is a record of your tests, not a general measure of AI capability. A marker reflects one task, tool and set of conditions.
map.partialResult: Usable with fixes includes your review and repair work.
map.keepNote: Keeping a task deliberately records your choice; it does not mean AI failed the task.

judgment.instruction: Choose an option, then compare the reasoning. Some situations support more than one answer.
judgment.progress: Ideas you have read and tried
judgment.noScore: Use the feedback to examine your reasoning; there is no score.

experiment.instruction: Choose one change small enough to try in your normal work.
experiment.oneAtATime: You already have an experiment in progress. Check in on it before starting another.
experiment.bookPrompt: The book goes further into the evidence and trade-offs behind these choices. Continue reading alongside your experiment.

retest.message: Your last test was {days} days ago. Consider trying it again, especially if the tool or the work has changed.
retest.scheduleNote: The 90-day reminder and 10-day experiment check-in are companion defaults, not intervals prescribed by the book.

privacy: Your entries stay in this browser on this device. This companion has no accounts, analytics or AI connection. Browser data can be cleared; export a copy if you want to keep it.
about: Co-Existence: The Next Phase of AI is by Ethan Mollick. This independently prepared, unofficial companion offers brief ideas and original exercises for applying them. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher. Buy the book to support the author’s work and read the evidence, arguments and qualifications behind these ideas.
